intro: Grace brings people together with its soft ash veneer finish and strong, family-friendly build. Spacious, stylish, and naturally inviting—it is your space's perfect addition.

features.title: Crown Ash veneer top for a natural touch
features.text: The MDF top features a Crown Ash veneer for a light, textured surface that mimics natural woodgrain with refined, earthy beauty.

features.title: Rubberwood frame for solid strength
features.text: The understructure is crafted from rubberwood, giving the table solid support and a dependable foundation that lasts.

features.title: Seats six with ease
features.text: A perfect fit for families, the Grace table offers plenty of space to dine, chat, or celebrate with comfort and style.

features.title: Warm brown tones
features.text: The deep brown hue brings a touch of elegance and timeless warmth, making it easy to pair with a wide range of décor themes.

features.title: Flat-pack friendly
features.text: Knockdown construction allows for simple setup, relocation, or storage—ideal for flexible and fast-paced lifestyles.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
